name: Axon password denylist
enforcement_status: REFERENCE ONLY - not currently wired into Axon or Supabase Auth
coverage_warning: Not an exhaustive list of breached passwords. Use a server-enforced breached-password check for comprehensive coverage.

sources.name: Kaggle 10000 Most Common Passwords
sources.note: Kaggle attributes dataset to SecLists, but CSV not directly obtained; no equivalence assertion.

sources.name: HIBP Pwned Passwords
sources.note: Continuously queried via hash-prefix API, NOT an embedded corpus.

rules.note: Block only tokens and trivial whole-password derivatives; not arbitrary phrases containing these words.

hibp_policy.preferred: Supabase Auth native Pwned Passwords integration on Pro+
hibp_policy.free_alternative: Only a genuinely server-authoritative flow which cannot be bypassed using direct Supabase Auth API
hibp_policy.behavior_on_api_failure: Fail closed for creating/changing a password; provide safe retry guidance; do not block existing user login.
